{"metadata":{"description":"Local personal memory and knowledge management for DeepSeek Harness. It supports local FTS, CPU-embedding or OpenAI-Compatible Embedding API.","id":"gh:1371638799","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-memoknow","slug":"twoyoung91/dsh-memoknow","topics":["agent-memory","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-desktop","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","knowledge-management","local-first","personal-knowledge-management","rag","sqlite"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Local personal memory and knowledge management for DeepSeek Harness. It supports local FTS, CPU-embe"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dding or OpenAI-Compatible Embedding API."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"MemoKnow is a local DeepSeek Harness plugin for personal memory and
user-imported knowledge. It stor"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"es structured records in SQLite, snapshots
original documents by SHA-256, combines FTS5 with optiona"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"l sqlite-vec semantic
retrieval, exposes agent tools, and provides a management screen inside DSH."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"MemoKnow is an independent community plugin, not an official DeepSeek Harness
component. It is desig"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ned for one person's local DSH profile; it is not a
multi-user service or a cloud sync product."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- Distills durable facts, preferences, and decisions from eligible completed
chat turns; explicit “p"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"lease remember” requests are processed sooner.
- Provides a review inbox in DSH **Settings → MemoKno"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"w**: inspect source
sessions and turns, edit suggestions, and approve or dismiss them. Approved
memo"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ries stay intact until you accept a proposed replacement.
- Lets you pause automatic learning, exclu"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"de individual sessions, adjust token
budgets, and inspect pending work and daily usage.
- Imports te"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"xt/Markdown, Word, PDF, CSV, and Excel documents as immutable local
knowledge snapshots with searcha"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ble text. Search the knowledge library,
preview extracted passages, and inspect or retry semantic in"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"dexing.
Embedded images are ignored.
- Lets you edit or permanently forget individual memories. Norm"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"al recall
includes only active, non-expired records.
- Starts with Local FTS, so no embedding model "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"or API key is needed. Optional
CPU or OpenAI-compatible embeddings improve knowledge retrieval."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## A quick look"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Open **DSH Settings → MemoKnow** to review memories, explore your knowledge
library, and control wha"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"t the plugin learns."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Review suggested memories and inspect their evidence before approving them:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Search imported knowledge and preview its extracted text:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Pause learning, set token budgets, and inspect pending sessions:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Start with Local FTS and adjust retrieval settings when needed:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"For step-by-step setup, daily use, backups, and troubleshooting, read the
user manual. Contributors "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"should read
CONTRIBUTING.md; release changes are in
CHANGELOG.md."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install the latest release"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Download the `.tgz` asset from GitHub Releases.
MemoKnow v0.2.0 supports Harness `0.2.0-rc.1` and th"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e declared compatible 0.1.x
tool API versions. Install the package into your web profile:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Restart DSH if it is already running, then open **Settings → MemoKnow**.
The release's `.tgz` includ"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"es the built plugin; GitHub's automatic source archives
require the source-build steps below."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Quick start from a checkout"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Requires Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, pnpm 11.7, and a compatible DSH
installation. Run these com"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"mands from the MemoKnow checkout:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"If your DSH installation is a source checkout and `dsh` is not on `PATH`, use
`pnpm dsh plugin --pro"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"file web add <absolute-path-to-MemoKnow>` from the DSH
repository root instead. To install a prebuil"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t GitHub Release tarball, use
`dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-tarball>`. Restart the web prof"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ile after
installation. Direct `github:` installation is not supported yet: Git installs
source file"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"s, and this package does not currently build during Git install.
These commands follow DSH's plugin "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"packaging guide
and CLI reference."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Restart DSH after installing, open **Settings → MemoKnow**, and select
**Setup & settings**. Local F"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"TS is the default and needs no model. Local CPU
embedding downloads the pinned INT8 `Xenova/multilin"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"gual-e5-small` model on
first enable (about 140 MiB including tokenizer files). OpenAI-compatible mo"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"de
validates its endpoint and model before activation. FTS remains available if an
embedding provide"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"r later becomes unavailable."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"If API mode is selected, put the key in the named environment variable (default
`MEMOKNOW_EMBEDDING_"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"API_KEY`). MemoKnow stores only that variable's name, never
the secret value."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Managed embedding policy"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Products that embed MemoKnow can enforce one OpenAI-compatible embedding
provider through the standa"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"rd Cordis plugin config while keeping the public
plugin source unchanged:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Managed mode projects these values into the runtime settings and disables their
controls in the mana"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"gement page. Settings API updates cannot override the
policy. The endpoint must use HTTPS, except fo"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"r loopback development addresses.
Only the environment-variable name belongs in config; the API key "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"value must be
provided through the process environment and is never returned by MemoKnow."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Local data"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The default data root is `$DSH_HOME/memoknow`, or `~/.dsh/memoknow` when
`DSH_HOME` is unset:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Use the plugin `dataDir` setting in the Cordis patch to choose another root.
SQLite is authoritative"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" for metadata and lifecycle state. Original document
snapshots are immutable files. FTS and sqlite-v"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ec indexes are derived data."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Knowledge imports"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The management page accepts pasted text/Markdown and files up to 25 MiB:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- Word `.doc` and `.docx`
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The management API is same-origin, rejects cross-site mutations, limits JSON
bodies to 1 MiB and fil"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"e requests to 26 MiB, validates file signatures, uses
parameterized SQL, sets restrictive browser he"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"aders, and never returns secret
settings. Keep the DSH web host bound to loopback unless you add an
"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"authenticated reverse proxy."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Please report security concerns through SECURITY.md rather
than a public issue."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Current limitations"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- Automatic distillation uses the active DSH session model; there is not yet a
separate model select"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"or. Token budgets are configurable in **Learning**.
- PDF import does not OCR scanned pages and deli"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"berately ignores images.
- Local CPU embedding runs on CPU through Transformers.js. Initial download"},{"id":"p39s4","text":" and
indexing can take time on slower connections or large libraries.
- Excel `.xls`, password-prote"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"cted files, macros, and embedded images are not
imported.
- Document previews show extracted text wi"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"th overlapping passages, not the
original layout or clickable page-level citations. Deletes use conf"},{"id":"p39s7","text":"irmation
dialogs; memory edits use a dedicated review form."}],"truncated":true}
